analysis: Use only the fixture assertions plus retained per-step CSV; report measured values, device, source/runtime/artifact hashes, stdout/stderr and exact gate outcome. No population inference.
claim_boundary: Even a pass is synthetic native heartbeat mechanics evidence. It does not establish anatomical heart qualification, electrical activation, ECG, clinical/physiological calibration, biological validity, or integrated whole-body Human capability.

model_and_intervention.fixture: synthetic 64-node, 156-tetrahedron hollow tissue shell; two environments; active periodic tension versus zero tension; synthetic vascular reservoirs, directional valves, and return resistor

predictions_and_refutation.failure_rule: Any missing artifact, failed step, or failed threshold refutes this fixture-level prediction; retain the failed result and do not tune/retry to pass.
predictions_and_refutation.native_status: all 400 steps accepted on physical Apple Metal for both environments

protocol.held_fixed: same initial fixture and clock; only active-tension input differs
protocol.independent_unit: one paired active and zero-tension environment in a single run; beats are repeated observations, not independent replicates
protocol.randomization: not applicable to deterministic paired fixture

purpose: exploratory paired native-runtime mechanism check; one run, no physiology or anatomy claim
question: Does the current native Metal fixture produce two repeatable active-tension ejections with tissue response and closed-loop volume/flow while its matched zero-tension environment remains the control?
stopping_rule: One declared paired run; stop after the 400-step attempt whether pass or fail.
